column1: # The power cut during a slot write, REPLAYED from committed captures: the part of
# P5e-6's longer video the owner chose to show as a replay rather than film (2026-10-19).
# read_reel).  Every segment is R8b's, 2026-10-07, on that gate's image, RLXFW-ID0
# F9ADC9E8 -- not v1.0's 9BB2BEC7 -- and every title says REPLAY: a replay renders
# committed bytes and is not a recording.
# What a clean clone regenerates, measured 2026-10-19 before this file was used: each
# builds in the working tree and one in a `git archive HEAD` tree, 8 of 8 files.  A
# screen recording of the replay is neither: its encoder and the tool's per-record
# sleeps (each at least as long as asked) are not reproducible.  The tool's own model
# of the running time is 64.661 s, 54.661 s of capture and 10.0 s of pauses; its
# 60 s ceiling belongs to v0.2's take, not to this clip.
